signature: SUBROUTINE DSPTRD( UPLO, N, AP, D, E, TAU, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$. On exit, if `UPLO = 'U'`, the diagonal and first superdiagonal of A are overwritten by the corresponding elements of the tridiagonal matrix T, and the elements above the first superdiagonal, with the array `TAU`, represent the orthogonal matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors; if `UPLO = 'L'`, the diagonal and first subdiagonal of A are over- written by the corresponding elements of the tridiagonal matrix T, and the elements below the first subdiagonal, with the array `TAU`, represent the orthogonal matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors. See Further Details.

params.name: d
params.reference: The diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T: $D(i) = A(i,i)$.

params.name: e
params.reference: The off-diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T: $E(i) = A(i,i+1)$ if `UPLO = 'U'`, $E(i) = A(i+1,i)$ if `UPLO = 'L'`.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors (see Further Details).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
